Name: Old Keshavnagar–Kharadi Bridge weir (bandhara)
Description: Thick white froth below the weir across most of the river width; turbid grey water
Source: Team field visit 29 Sep 2026 (GPS Map Camera photo)

Name: Sewage outfall pipe near the bridge
Description: Concrete outfall pipe discharging foamy, greenish wastewater into the river; algae on the pipes below

Name: Garbage dumped on the riverbank beside the bridge
Description: Large pile of plastic bags, clothes, wood and debris on the rocky bank

Name: Waste on the bridge walkway
Description: Plastic and cloth waste left along the bridge; waste thrown into the river from here

Description: Bottled samples were turbid and yellowish-grey, with suspended particles
